name: triceps-extension-barbell-standing-overhead
title: Triceps Extension: Barbell (Standing, Overhead)
primer: This is a double arm barbell version of a behind the neck triceps exercise.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your back straight and your abs drawn in.
Hold a barbell or EZ Curl bar with your hands about 6-8 inches apart and your palms facing up.
Raise the bar over your head and slowly lower the bar in an arc behind your head, towards your back.
Slowly raise the bar back up to the starting position.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your head during the exercise.
